name: versioned-report-contract-as-discriminated-union
description: Versioned report contracts read best as a zod discriminated union on schemaVersion: each supported version keeps its own member schema (strictObject + superRefine), unknown versions fail at the discriminator naming the readable set, and TS infers the member union so consumers narrow on the literal. Keep metric ownership as declared ids on per-analysis entries rather than duplicating values — the report areas stay the single source of truth.
